description: Agents forces one call to tool2 with the arguments the prompt gives. The gateway sends tool2, not tool1, because EnableByoGeminiForAgents is on in every environment; it accepts one or two calls because EnableParallelToolCallsExemption is on.

messages.content:
Please process the following:
1. A string input: "This is a test."
2. A numeric input: 42

function.name: tool2
function.description: Processes a generic user input, either string or numeric. Use option1 for string input and option2 for numeric input.

ifBodyContains: Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model. Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead.
retries.why: the model wants max_completion_tokens; the gateway sends it once more with that field

ifBodyContains: are not supported for this model
retries.why: the model refuses a forced tool choice; the gateway sends it once more with tool choice auto

checks.says: choices is an array; each message's content is a string and each tool call's arguments a string
checks.jq: (.choices | type) == "array" and all(.choices[]; ((.message.content // "") | type) == "string" and all((.message.tool_calls // [])[]; (.function.arguments | type) == "string"))

checks.says: the answer comes from the assistant
every call is tool2; one call carries one of the two expected argument sets, two calls carry both
checks.jq: [.choices[0].message.tool_calls[]? | {name: .function.name, args: (.function.arguments | fromjson? // null)}] as $calls | [{"parameter1": "option1", "parameter2": "This is a test."}, {"parameter1": "option2", "parameter2": "42"}] as $expected | ($calls | length) as $n | $n > 0 and all($calls[]; .name == "tool2" and .args != null) and (if $n == 1 then any($expected[]; . == $calls[0].args) elif $n == 2 then ($calls | map(.args) | sort) == ($expected | sort) else false end)
